primary_question: Does leakage-safe supervised auxiliary pretraining on quality-controlled MIMIC-III PPG improve MIMIC-BP validation performance versus architecture-matched scratch training?
forecasting_status: secondary feasibility analysis until event-enriched continuous PPG/ABP is available

source_policy.high_confidence: finite AND not step_artifact AND abs(lag_correlation)>=0.5 AND ppg_sqi>=0.5 AND abp_sqi>=0.5
source_policy.source_split: grouped by official subject_id; 15 percent validation

input.normalization: median/IQR for PPG and MAD for derivatives

screening.primary_metric: mean of SBP MAE and DBP MAE on target validation

confirmation_if_screening_positive.selection: best delta_mean_mae with no target worsening greater than 0.5 mmHg
confirmation_if_screening_positive.evaluation: patient-grouped repeated validation and existing external cohorts
confirmation_if_screening_positive.required_claim: improvement must not rely on target test or mapping-unknown source windows

forecasting_gate.minimum_before_deep_claim: at least 200 independent transitions with subject-disjoint evaluation
